This file was created from scratch in commit b4639602a22a16c7bd671ffd1cc2d1dafabd501d — it introduced the new `CustomPieChart` class, but the anonymous `PieRadarChartTouchListener` subclass body was missing the `performHighlight(Highlight h, MotionEvent e)` method wrapper, leaving bare statements directly in the class body. This is actually invalid/malformed Java (the override never actually took effect as intended, and effectively wouldn't compile as written, or at best the statements were dead/misplaced). This is the only commit touching this file besides the fix itself, so it's the sole candidate.

## Bug-Introducing Commits
BIC: b4639602a22a16c7bd671ffd1cc2d1dafabd501d

## Reasoning
(1) I checked the file history with `git log --follow` for `CustomPieChart.java` and found only two commits ever touched it: the fix itself (`dc4ddf0`) and the commit that created the file (`b463960`). I then viewed the full diff of `b463960`.

(2) The commit added `CustomPieChart.java`, intending to override `performHighlight` in an anonymous `PieRadarChartTouchListener` subclass to prevent un-highlighting behavior. However, the method declaration line `protected void performHighlight(Highlight h, MotionEvent e) {` was omitted — the `if (h != null && !h.equalTo(mLastHighlighted)) {...}` block was placed directly inside the anonymous class body instead of inside an overriding method. This means the intended override of `performHighlight` never actually existed, so the base class's default behavior (which presumably unhighlights on certain touch events) remained in effect — the actual bug described in the class's own Javadoc ("Override to disable unhighlight function") was never achieved.

(3) The fix commit `dc4ddf0` simply wraps that exact same code block in the missing `protected void performHighlight(Highlight h, MotionEvent e) { ... }` method signature, and removes now-unused imports (`View`, `ChartTouchListener`, `OnChartGestureListener`) that were present but never used — consistent with a copy-paste/omission error in the original commit rather than any later regression. Since this is the only commit in history that created/modified this logic before the fix, it is the clear bug-introducing commit.
